title: Chime
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A short-story collection. In the lead story, high school student Miyakuni confesses to his easygoing teacher Sakuma and keeps pressing after being turned down; other stories include an obsessive childhood friend (MU). The English publisher's blurb calls it a "sometimes scandalous, sometimes heartwarming" collection of the artist's "steamiest work" (AniList, from June Manga).
life_message: Persistent devotion is shown as the way to win love, even across forbidden lines.
